info.title: Bust A Groove Recompiled
info.author: brankoRn
info.description: Native PC and Nintendo Switch port of Bu
info.details:
Native PC and Nintendo Switch port of Bust A Groove (PlayStation, 1998), built by static recompilation: the game's MIPS code was translated to C ahead of time and compiled natively. It is not an emulator.

Nintendo Switch (homebrew)
Download BustAGroove-vX.Y.Z-switch-nro.zip and copy its switch folder to the root of the SD card.
Put your .cue and .bin in SD:/switch/BustAGroove/.
Launch it from the Homebrew Menu.
Optional HOME menu icon: also install BustAGroove-vX.Y.Z-switch.nsp (needs sigpatches). The NSP still reads the game and settings from SD:/switch/BustAGroove/, so step 1 and 2 are still required.
